sections.heading: Verdict shape for Nimble

sections.heading: Who Nimble is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Nimble when you want a relationship CRM with Gmail/Outlook sync and simple Business pricing..

Avoid if: Compare HubSpot, Capsule, or Pipedrive if you need freemium, deeper automation, or multi-tier packaging..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with HubSpot on the same job-to-be-done.
